messages:
dina: Heads-up: planning the offline mirror cutover for private installer images tonight during the 00:00–01:00 UTC window. Need KMS rotation and cosign key swap before the mirror switch.
ops-bot: Deploy window reserved: 00:00-01:00 UTC. CI artifacts expected by 23:30 UTC. tag: v2.8.1-offline
samir: Copying artifacts to staging mirror now. I'll run the checksum compare script once upload finishes. ping me when cosign sigs are ready.
jess: Reminder: we must not rotate primary KMS until cosign signatures for the new key are verified against the existing key. Otherwise airgap clients will fail verify.
dina: Agree. Plan: 23:40 - upload & checksum, 23:45 - cosign with temporary key (kms-rotate-prepare), 23:50 - verify sigs on staging, 00:00 - atomic mirror switch, 00:10 - rotate KMS alias to new key. rollback path: revert mirror DNS + reapply old manifest and key alias.
ops-bot: checklist created: 
1) artifacts uploaded
2) checksum ok
3) cosign sigs present
4) smoke deploy to canary site
5) mirror DNS TTL lowered
6) alias rotation
Use /deploy offline-mirror --canary
samir: Upload done, checksums match: sha256:abc123def4567890... . Waiting on cosign sigs from jess.
jess: cosign signed with kms-rotate-prepare key: signature attached. Verification log:
```
$ cosign verify-blob --key k8s://projects/keys/kms-rotate-prepare artifact.tar.gz.sig
Verified OK
```
oliver: Quick question: do we need to ship updated release notes about KMS change? some customers need pre-notice for HSM rotations.
dina: Yes — release-notes snippet added to the ticket and emailed to private-customers@redwood.com. Also set TTL to 30s for mirror DNS at 23:55.
ops-bot: canary deploy initiated at 23:58. status: started
samir: canary passed basic smoke tests (healthz, sample inference, image integrity). logs ok.
jess: verified cosign on canary nodes post-pull.
dina: Proceeding with atomic switch at 00:00.
ops-bot: mirror switch completed. TTL resumed to normal at 00:12.
oliver: Started KMS alias rotation at 00:10 per plan; now completed at 00:13. monitoring for signature failures.
samir: No signature failures reported. rollback not needed.
dina: Closing thread. Postmortem note: add a regression check on cosign key ID in our installer validation step.
